question: Which among the following is NOT one of the four locations of the 'Kumbh Mela'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The Kumbha Mela is held at the same site for 12 years but there are four major Kumbha sites where it is celebrated, so it is said that after 3 years a Kumbha Mela is celebrated.
 
• Ardha Kumbha is celebrated every 6 years whereas Mahakumbha is celebrated every 12 years.
 
• It is the major Hindu pilgrimage.
 
• It is celebrated on river banks
 
 
• Prayagraj (river Ganges), 
 
• Haridwar ( river Ganges), 
 
• Nashik (Godavari river), and 
 
• Ujjain ( river Shipra).
 
 
 
• **Hence Varanasi is the correct answer.**
